issues.description: getSourceMap reads and parses files on every stack frame with no caching
issues.detail: Per-frame existsSync + readFileSync + convertSourceMap.fromSource turns each error into O(frames * fileSize) disk work for the same file. Memoize by file path so a stable fact (the source map for a file) is computed once. On noisy runs this is a real hot path during error serialization.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) semantic change is undocumented and lacks a direct unit test
issues.detail: The fix shifts resolvedSources from resolving against the map URL to resolving against its parent directory. That matches the sourcemap spec, but DecodedMap is shared utility code and the only evidence is a CLI snapshot. Add a comment stating the invariant and a direct unit test in packages/utils so this is not regressed.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' to silently swallow missing map files
issues.detail: Returning the literal string '{}' fakes a valid empty source map when the referenced file is missing, hiding broken sourceMappingURL references and missing .map files. Return undefined and let the caller decide, or log once at debug level. Don't lie to the parser about real failure modes.

issues.description: Mixing 'pathe' and 'node:path' in the same file invites Windows separator bugs
issues.detail: The file already imports resolve from pathe, but the new code imports node:path and uses path.resolve/path.dirname. pathe normalizes separators cross-platform; node:path does not. Use pathe consistently to match the codebase's voice and avoid subtle Windows path issues in sourceMappingURL resolution.

issues.description: readFileSync on a hot error path lacks try/catch and can crash error reporting
issues.detail: existsSync + readFileSync is racy, and readFileSync can still throw (EACCES, EISDIR, symlink loop). If it throws inside getSourceMap, parseErrorStacktrace dies and the user sees a sourcemap error instead of their actual test failure. Wrap in try/catch and fall through to no source map.

issues.description: extractSourcemapFromFile is copied from Vite with no abstraction boundary or stated reason for new convert-source-map dep
issues.detail: The helper is inlined from Vite via commit SHA, and convert-source-map is added even though @jridgewell/trace-mapping is already used in DecodedMap. Two copies will drift silently; two libraries for the same value adds mental overhead. Import from Vite if exposed, or note the divergence and justify the duplicate dependency.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a real fix with the right shape but under-audited and rushed in execution. The DecodedMap resolve change is correct per the sourcemap spec but undocumented and only covered by a CLI snapshot. The external-module path in test-run.ts has three concrete code-quality issues all three reviewers converge on: no memoization of per-file source maps, a '{}' fallback that lies about missing files, and missing invariant/test coverage. Secondary concerns include mixed pathe/node:path imports, unguarded sync I/O on the error path, and a new dependency duplicating jridgewell capability. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — tighten the screws before landing.
